messages:
Aisha Patel: FYI — we need to schedule the PIR for last night's paging storm (INC-2026). Root cause & customer impact review + action owners. I can facilitate if no one else volunteers, but prefer someone not on current oncall week. Suggested windows: Tue 09:00-10:00 PT or Wed 16:00-17:00 PT. :calendar:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026 summary — triggered 2026-03-14 23:12 UTC. Affected: hosted inference for certain Dedicated customers in us-west-2. Severity: Sev2. Pager routed to infra-oncall -> mitigated via rollback at 23:44 UTC. Full timeline: 23:12 alert, 23:20 mitigation attempt, 23:44 rollback, 00:10 stable. See /incidents/INC-2026 for timeline and logs.

Diego Ramos: I can facilitate but only Wed after 15:30 PT. Otherwise happy to prep the timeline.

Priya Shah: Tue morning works for me. Avail both slots but prefer Tue 09:00 PT. Will invite CS and PM.

Sam Carter: +1 for Tue 09. Can we get a quick pre-read (5 slides) with error rates, affected customers, and rollback rationale?

Nina (SRE): I'll own the mitigation replay and will prepare a short section on the autoscaler interaction. Need to pull the KV cache metrics and the kernel-selection logs. I'll add links to logs.

Tom H: If no one else takes it, I can chair Tue 09. I'm off Wed afternoon.

Maya L: Reminder: several customers in the EU had delayed retries too. CS needs to be on the call. @Olivia (PM) can you confirm? :point_up:

Olivia (PM): Confirmed — CS and two account owners will join Tue 09. I'll send invites and an agenda (10-15m customer impact, 20m technical RCA, 15m remediation & action items).

oncall-rotation-bot: @Tom H is oncall Thu-Fri; suggested facilitator should not be scheduled for oncall within 48h of PIR.

Aisha Patel: OK sounds like Tue 09:00 PT is the winner. Tom H will facilitate. Agenda outline (rough):
- 09:00 intro & objectives (Tom)
- 09:05 customer impact summary (Olivia/CS)
- 09:15 timeline & mitigation replay (Nina + infra)
- 09:30 RCA deep dive (Diego/Priya)
- 09:45 remediation plan & owners (all)
- 09:55 wrap & next steps

Aisha Patel: Action item starter list (will fill details after pre-read):
- AI-1: Draft postmortem doc and timeline (owner: Diego Ramos) — due Tue EOD
- AI-2: Export autoscaler & kernel logs and attach to doc (owner: Nina (SRE)) — due Mon EOD
- AI-3: Customer impact notes and communications draft (owner: Olivia (PM)) — due Tue 12:00 PT
- AI-4: Validate rollback procedure and add checklist (owner: Sam Carter) — due Fri EOD

Diego Ramos: I'll take AI-1. Will upload a first draft by Monday morning.

Nina (SRE): Taking AI-2. Quick note: use this query for logs export:

```
# logs export
./tools/incident-export --incident INC-2026 --range 2026-03-14T23:00:00Z/2026-03-15T01:00:00Z --output s3://rwinf-incident-exports/INC-2026
```

Priya Shah: I'll help with the RCA section and map the perf regression to the model variant rollout.

Sam Carter: I can own AI-4 but want Diego + Nina to confirm the exact rollback artifacts I should test against.

Olivia (PM): I'll post the CS attendee list and customer contacts in the doc. Also prepping a brief comms template.

Tom H: I'll create the calendar invite and add the agenda. Ping me if you need me to adjust. I'll also act as facilitator and keep time. :thumbsup:

Aisha Patel: Two follow-ups before PIR:
- Please add any logs, dashboards, or small runnable repros to the doc so we can triage quickly.
- If you have any blocker for Tue 09, comment now.

Diego Ramos: small caveat — I'm traveling Mon night UTC+2; I can still upload but might be slow for edits.

Priya Shah: Noted. I'll be in the doc 08:30 PT to prep slides.

Maya L: CS will bring three customer impact summaries. I'll drop the account IDs in the doc in a bit.

incident-bot: Reminder set: PIR meeting scheduled for 2026-03-17 09:00 PT. Calendar event created: https://calendar.company/ev/INC-2026-pir

Aisha Patel: Great — last item: facilitator handoff notes. Tom, please capture the start-of-call blurb and the 'what success looks like' statement so we can post an executive summary after. Also please capture decisions inline with the action items.

Tom H: Will do. I'll also mark any blockers as follow-up issues in the infra repo and link them in the doc.

Sam Carter: +1. One more ask — can we get a short snapshot of token-level latency distribution during the window? That helped earlier with triage.

Nina (SRE): I'll attach the latency histogram and a quick python snippet to generate it from metric exports:

```
import json
# load metrics
# bucket by token position
```

Priya Shah: thanks everyone. See you Tue 09 PT.

Olivia (PM): Sending the invite now. :email:
